name: Fruit Slice
description: Swipe to slice flying fruit, chain combos and dodge the bombs.

description_i18n.es: Desliza para cortar fruta en el aire, encadena combos y esquiva las bombas.

prompt: A swipe game like Fruit Ninja: fruits fly up from the bottom, swipe to slice them with a glowing blade trail, juice splashes, combos for slicing several at once, bombs that end the game, 3 lives, arcade and zen modes. Make it addictive and viral: a daily challenge, streak or progress that brings people back every day, very satisfying animations, haptics with Acornix.vibrate and sounds made with Web Audio, records saved with Acornix.db, and a Share button that draws a beautiful result card on a canvas with the result, the app name and a small footer Made with Acornix, then shares it with Acornix.files.share and the file name result.png. Polished, colorful, premium design.
author: gonzaroman
